name: PID_Line_Tracer_V2
description: Improved dual-color-sensor PID line tracer using standard SPIKE-RT v0.2.0 APIs only. Startup mode menu: LEFT selects line tracing, RIGHT selects calibration, CENTER confirms. Calibration drives straight across a transverse black line from white to black to white, independently measuring both sensors. On success it returns to the mode menu; line tracing uses normalized per-sensor reflectance, a 10 ms cyclic notification, measured control interval, filtered derivative, conditional integral anti-windup, adaptive speed, and force sensor C for start/stop. No driver modifications.
warning: Calibration requires both color sensors to start on the white surface, with the robot facing straight toward a black line that crosses the direction of travel. Keep the robot unobstructed during the low-speed calibration pass. Calibration is held in RAM and must be repeated after a power cycle. Verify motor direction, calibration thresholds, control timing, and PID gains on the actual robot.
